hero.title: Learning English is an adventure
hero.subtitle: Short lessons, fun games and small rewards help your child learn a little every day. You always know how far they have come.

features.title: One step of the journey every day

levels.title: Lessons by level
levels.description: Lessons go from easy to harder. Finishing one unlocks the next.

games.title: Mini-games
games.description: Quizzes and matching words to pictures help vocabulary stick without getting boring.

rewards.title: Points and badges
rewards.description: Every finished lesson earns points and badges that keep motivation up.

account.title: Create a parent account
account.description: Register with your email. Children need no email.

profile.title: Add a profile for your child
profile.description: Each child gets their own profile with a nickname and an avatar.

learn.title: They learn, you follow along
learn.description: Your child learns through lessons and games; you see each child's progress and rewards.

parents.title: Peace of mind for parents
parents.privacy: No email or personal details needed from children.
parents.control: Only parents manage their children's profiles and account.
parents.progress: See finished lessons, scores and badges.
parents.content: Content written by our team, never generated automatically.

register.title: Register a parent account
register.description: Create an account to manage your children's learning profiles. Children need no email.
register.acceptTerms: I accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
